cases.title: Website operations, end to end
cases.body: Webflow, analytics, consent, hiring flows, structured data, and ongoing performance work, with one owner across the whole surface.
cases.chain: problem: no owner across seams → move: single-operator coverage → result: site holds shape between teams → limits: numbers shared on request
cases.attribution: sole operator: platform, analytics, consent, schema

cases.title: Marketing site and campaigns
cases.body: Campaign pages with attention to consent, embedded video, and the details that keep measurement intact.
cases.chain: problem: measurement broke at edges → move: consent-safe tracking layer → result: clean data through campaigns → limits: baseline pre-dates tooling
cases.attribution: sole operator: tracking, consent, video embeds

cases.title: 1,500 records, one system
cases.body: Property content rebuilt as architecture, with schema and answer-shaped content that search and AI engines parse.
cases.chain: problem: pages built twice, schema an afterthought → move: CMS architecture + schema @graph → result: one system, machine-readable → limits: citation volume accruing
cases.attribution: sole operator: CMS structure, schema design

cases.title: From 38 styles to one
cases.body: Marketing site rebuilt on tokens and a section library. Pages stopped being designed twice.
cases.chain: problem: 38 one-off styles → move: token law + section library → result: pages assembled, not redesigned → limits: library still grows
cases.attribution: sole operator: token system, section library

cases.title: One owner across the seams.
cases.body: Strategy, implementation, tracking, QA, and coordination, joined up so the site does not lose its shape between teams.
cases.chain: problem: handoffs drop details → move: one owner across the seams → result: site holds its shape between teams → limits: scoped to the surfaces I run
cases.attribution: sole operator across the named surfaces

principles.title: Know what the site needs to do.
principles.body: Start with the job, the audience, and the constraints. Then choose the right build.

principles.title: Make the invisible parts dependable.
principles.body: Forms, data, consent, redirects, accessibility, and performance get the same checks as the page.

principles.title: Leave the team in a better position.
principles.body: Build for the next edit, the next campaign, and the person who has to maintain it.

exhibits.title: The system, with reasons on
exhibits.body: Every token, section, and rule on this site carries its why. The same system discipline I ship for clients, turned on my own site.

exhibits.title: D.I.C.E., deterministic by design
exhibits.body: Same seed, same draw, forever. A working deterministic creative engine with real hashes.
